name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, document roots, static site content, and service lifecycle management. Also provides development TLS and host security controls including fail2ban, UFW, sysctl hardening, and SSH restrictions.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis password authentication, service enablement, log directory creation, and a workaround for selected replication settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from Git, installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, creates the application environment and database, and runs Uvicorn through systemd.
